title: Context and providers: Share a stable theme value through a provider while rejecting missing provider setup in a custom consumer
description: A practical React 19 lesson for context and providers, with an intentionally failing starter, complete TypeScript instructor implementation, local assertions and honest runtime scope.
objectives: Share a stable theme value through a provider while rejecting missing provider setup in a custom consumer.
Repair the broken behavior in the react-context-provider starter.
Demonstrate correct and edge-case outcomes using offline tests.
rubric: I can articulate the React 19 contract for context and providers.
I can reproduce, repair and test the 06.04.01 starter case.
I can explain the difference between a local fixture and production persistence or browser behavior.
